en.title: Lexington Parks Face Thousands of Accessibility Fixes Amid City Backlog
en.summary: Lexington officials report thousands of accessibility improvements needed in city parks and facilities to meet disability standards, sparking debate over prioritization and funding. The Bronx intersection received curb cuts and audible signals after years of complaints, Auracast enhances classroom audio for deaf students, and a website accessibility study reveals 95.9% non-compliance. Salina's third annual accessibility seminar wraps up, highlighting inclusive practices.

highlights.title: Lexington parks, facilities need thousands of accessibility fixes. How should city address the backlog?
Bronx Intersection Gets Accessibility Repairs Following Years Of Complaints
Salina hosts third annual accessibility seminar with OCCK

zh-TW.title: 列克星敦公園千項無障礙待修
zh-TW.summary: 列克星敦官員指出，城市公園與設施需要數千項無障礙改進以符合殘障人士標準，引發優先處理與資金分配的討論。布朗克斯交叉口在多年投訴後完成坡道切割與聲音訊號改善，Auracast 技術提升課堂音訊無障礙，而網站無障礙合規報告顯示 95.9% 網站未通過基本測試。薩利納舉辦第三屆年度無障礙研討會，聚焦殘障包容實踐。

highlights.title: 列克星敦公園與設施需要數千項無障礙修復，市府應如何應對積壓？
布朗克斯交叉口進行無障礙維修
